title: finding(docs,fields): packages/fields/README.md names `FieldRegistry`, a symbol nothing in the repo exports — one prose hit, no gate reads it
body:
Measured on `origin/main` at `3c6394cb2` (and on the batch-36 head `a511f23ec`), while repairing this page's snippets for objectui#5174 (batch 36).

`packages/fields/README.md:8` reads:

- 🔌 **Plugin System** - `FieldRegistry` allows registering custom renderers or overriding standard ones.

`FieldRegistry` is code-formatted, so it reads as a symbol a consumer can import. There is no such symbol anywhere in this repository:

```
$ grep -rn "FieldRegistry" --include=*.ts --include=*.tsx --include=*.md --include=*.mdx packages apps content
packages/fields/README.md:8:- 🔌 **Plugin System** - `FieldRegistry` allows ...
```

One hit, and it is the README line itself. `packages/fields/dist/index.d.ts` exports no `FieldRegistry` either. The real surface is the pair of functions the same section's snippets use — `registerFieldRenderer(type, renderer)` (`packages/fields/src/index.tsx:2137`) and `getCellRenderer(fieldType)` (`:2320`) — over a module-private `const fieldRegistry = new Map(...)` at `:2130` that is deliberately not exported.

**Why no gate catches it.** `check:readme-exports` judges IMPORT BINDINGS inside fenced blocks; `check:doc-snippets` compiles the fences. A backticked identifier in PROSE is read by neither, so this phantom survives both gates going green — which they now do for this page (batch 36 took it into the compiled tier and deleted its `UNGATED_DOCS` row).

**Why it is a defect and not a nickname.** An AI or a human reading "the `FieldRegistry` allows registering custom renderers" writes `import { FieldRegistry } from '@object-ui/fields'` and gets nothing. The neighbouring fence already teaches the correct call, so the page contradicts itself one screen apart.

**Suggested fix (one line, mechanical).** Name the exported function instead of the non-existent class:

- 🔌 **Plugin System** - `registerFieldRenderer` registers custom renderers, or overrides standard ones.

Filed unassigned, `finding` label only, out of batch 36's scope (that batch's surface is the page's two `tsx` fences and this page's `UNGATED_DOCS` row). Deduped against a REST listing of all 289 open non-PR issues (control term "readme" -> 12 hits, so the read is real; "FieldRegistry" -> 0).
